mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.10%, it triggers an extreme monetary easing phase that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days within the next week.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.10%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in payrolls indicate accelerating labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days through joint series behavior.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises simultaneously, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions signaled by housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units, S&P 500 underperforms due to overvaluation and profit-taking, producing negative forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1200.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates strengthening manufacturing output and supply chain efficiency, supporting corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days without regime conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint increases in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust demand expansion that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through interaction effects.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles signaled by FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0%, S&P 500 experiences negative returns over 60 days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.
